title: AnalysisReport
description: One inspection report. Generic shape used for manual, scheduled, meta-cycle, supporting-agent, and external-monitor analyses such as queue health, docs drift, stale jobs, roadmap alignment, token-spend review, QA status, architecture drift, and security posture. The Markdown sibling at <reportId>.md is the durable human artifact; this JSON is the additive app contract. Storage and producer rules are documented in docs/analysis-reports.md.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version for this record. Bumped only when a non-additive change forces readers to fork. Additive optional fields keep version 1.

reportId.description: Stable id for this report. ULID or UUID v7 are recommended so the lexical order matches creation time. Matches the Markdown filename stem on disk.

createdAt.description: UTC timestamp at which the report was created. Must end in Z.

scope.description: Primary scope for this report. The kind decides which optional pointers are populated.

kind.description: Workspace: cross-project audit. Project: default project-level inspection. Task: bound to one job folder. Run: bound to one CLI invocation. TimeWindow: covers a wall-clock window across one or more projects.

project.description: Project name as it appears in WatchPaths. Required for Project, Task, and Run scopes; null for Workspace; optional for TimeWindow.

jobId.description: Job folder id when scope.kind is Task or Run.

runIndex.description: 1-based run index when scope.kind is Run.

timeWindow.description: Wall-clock window for TimeWindow scope. UTC, ISO-8601.

producer.description: Who wrote the report. Descriptive only; producer kind does not grant any capability.

kind.description: Manual: user-initiated button click. Scheduled: cron-like cadence configured per project. MetaCycle: orchestrator meta-cycle (Layer 2 1/2). SupportingAgent: a CLI agent invoked for meta work (security audit, UX/UI council, source-map skill). ExternalMonitor: Layer 3 external system review monitor.

participantId.description: Optional Agent Message Bus participant id of the producer. When set, joins this report to the bus's participant graph.

agent.description: Free-form CLI / tool label, e.g. 'claude', 'codex', 'system-review.sh'. Optional descriptor; the participantId is the joinable id.

trigger.description: What caused the analysis to run. Mirrors producer.kind in the simple case; carried as a separate field so a single producer can fire for multiple trigger reasons (e.g. a supporting agent invoked manually vs on a schedule).

topic.description: kebab-case subject of the report. Examples: queue-health, docs-drift, roadmap-alignment, stale-jobs, security-posture, architecture-drift, qa-status, token-spend, runtime-observability, are-we-on-track, ux-ui.

summary.description: One-sentence verdict shown in the report list. Detail belongs in the Markdown sibling.

severity.description: Highest finding severity in the report. Drives the badge in the project-level Analysis Reports surface.

parseStatus.description: How the UI should present this report. Structured: both Markdown and a valid JSON sidecar. Unstructured: Markdown only. MalformedJson: Markdown plus a sidecar that failed to parse or validate; the Markdown stays visible.

parseError.description: When parseStatus is MalformedJson, a one-line reason a reviewer can read without re-running the analysis.

tags.description: Optional, free-form labels for filtering: 'pre-update-stable', 'post-batch', 'merge-freeze', 'release-prep'. kebab-case.

references.description: Typed pointers to the evidence the report rests on. References are joined against existing stores; the report does not copy raw logs.

kind.description: Pointer type. Job: job folder identity. Run: one CLI invocation. Commit: <repoSlug>@<sha>. Screenshot: path under <job>/results/. BusMessage: AgentMessage id. RuntimeEvent: typed event name + id (often bridged through the bus today). PreviousReport: another AnalysisReport id. LogSlice: <jobId>:<runIndex>:<startLine>-<endLine>. Doc: a path under the source repo (README, AGENTS, ADR file, etc.).

ref.description: Stable identifier for the referenced object, in the shape documented for kind in docs/analysis-reports.md.

label.description: Optional human-readable label shown in drill-down chips. Falls back to ref when absent.

findings.description: Optional typed findings. Each finding has a topic, severity, and a one-line message; evidence pointers reference the references array by index or by ref.

topic.description: kebab-case label, e.g. stale-job, missing-artefact, doc-drift.

evidenceRefs.description: Optional pointers (matching references[].ref) that back the finding.

followUpTaskSuggestions.description: Candidate follow-up tasks. The user (or a producer with creation rights) creates the actual job through the existing task-creation entry point; suggestions never enqueue silently. Source-code edits are out of scope: a follow-up runs as a normal queued task.

relatedTopic.description: Optional grouping label so the UI can colour or filter suggestions.

targetState.description: Initial state for the queued follow-up. Default 1-preparation; 2-ready is reserved for templated topics with a fixed contract.

createdJobId.description: When the suggestion has been turned into a real queued job, the id of that job. Until set, the suggestion is a candidate, not a commitment.

markdownPath.description: Optional pointer to the Markdown sibling, relative to the workspace root. Consumers normally compute this from reportId; the field exists for the rare case where the Markdown lives under a non-default path.
